description_expanded: OverviewCOASTAL CHATEAU A Lakefront 30A Retreat for Rest and Connection WELCOME TO COASTAL CHATEAU There is something special about life along 30A. Mornings begin slowly here. The sun rises over the lake, coffee in hand on the deck, the water still and quiet. You might watch someone paddle out on a kayak or cast a fishing line from the dock while the rest of the house wakes up. Days here unfold gently. A bike ride to the beach, an afternoon paddle across the lake to a quiet stretch of sand, or a walk to The Hub for ice cream, music, and dinner under the lights. Evenings bring everyone back together. Stories around the fire pit. Barefoot kids running through the yard. The soft sound of the water just beyond the dock. Coastal Chateau was created to be that kind of place; a home where families and friends gather, slow down, and enjoy the simple rhythm of the coast. THE SETTING Tucked along a peaceful lake in Seacrest/Inlet Beach, Coastal Chateau offers the best of both worlds: the calm of lakefront living and easy access to the Gulf. From the private dock, you can kayak, paddleboard, or pedal across the lake to a quiet beach access just a short paddle away. If you prefer to walk or bike, Gulf Lakes Public Beach Access is only about half a mile down the road. It’s a rare feature on 30A... the freedom to reach the beach by water or by land. OUTDOOR LIVING Life at Coastal Chateau naturally spills outdoors. The backyard opens directly to the lake, with space to gather, play, and relax throughout the day. Here you’ll find: A private dock perfect for fishing or launching kayaks 2 kayaks, 2 paddle boards, and a pedal boat for exploring the lake 4 bikes for cruising down 30A A large deck overlooking the water for morning coffee or sunset drinks A fire pit for relaxed evenings under the stars Beach chairs, umbrellas, and toys ready for your beach days Whether you're starting the morning with a paddle or ending the evening by the fire, the lake becomes part of the rhythm of your stay. THE HOME Inside, Coastal Chateau is designed for comfort and connection. The home features 3 bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms, comfortably sleeping up to 8 guests. The living areas are open and welcoming, making it easy to gather after a day in the sun, share meals together, or simply relax. Large windows and the balcony overlook the lake, letting the natural beauty of the water become part of the home. The fully equipped kitchen has everything needed for preparing family meals, beach picnics, or a casual breakfast before heading out for the day. Sleeping Arrangements Primary Bedroom: King bed Guest Bedroom: Queen bed Loft Space: Two twin trundles (perfect for kids or extra guests) NEARBY One of the joys of this location is how easily you can explore 30A. Within walking or biking distance you'll find The Big Chill, a favorite local gathering place with restaurants, live music, outdoor movies, and family-friendly fun. And of course, the emerald water and white sand beaches of the Gulf are just minutes away. WHY GUESTS LOVE COASTAL CHATEAU Guests often tell us that what makes this home special is the balance it offers. You have the beauty and excitement of the beach… but also the quiet calm of the lake. You can spend the day exploring 30A… or never leave the dock. It’s a place where kids can play, adults can unwind, and everyone can reconnect. A PLACE TO GATHER Whether you're planning a family vacation, a friends' getaway, or simply a few days to breathe and slow down, Coastal Chateau offers a place to make those moments happen. We hope your time here is filled with sunshine, laughter, long dinners, and the kind of memories that bring you back year after year. Welcome to the lake. Welcome to 30A. Welcome to Coastal Chateau. Coastal Chateau: Upper floor of a two-level cottage, it can be rented alone or with Bella Vista. The dock is shared if rented separately.Show less
